title: Standalone Reject-PDU coverage seed
purpose: Cover documented MMS PDU tag 0xa4 with a compact but complete standalone seed that is structurally valid and distinct from response/error duplicates.
expected_behavior: A BER/MMS parser should dispatch on the Reject-PDU tag and continue into the small nested content.
constraints_preserved: Outer PDU tag 0xa4 matches documented Reject-PDU.
BER definite length 0x05 matches enclosed content.
No truncation or incomplete outer TLV is used.
issue_safety_notes: This is a minimal valid tag-coverage seed and not a replay of any historical reject-path crash.
